Text: Carries fluid in a straight line.
Beavers argued for days about whether water prefers to travel in straight lines. The pipe settled it.
Turns a pipe run 90°. Flip for the other way.
The only junction that connects horizontal pipes to vertical risers. You can stack a Riser on it.
It goes every way at once. The water does not mind.
